summary: Iteration 22 tested end-to-end: 5 Sofía templates, 7 tools (with money-guardrail), backend date helpers in America/Bogota, calls webhook (unauthenticated) + auth-gated /calls list, custom-agent BETA create/patch/test-call flow (no Retell creds), legacy tools back-compat, and full Llamadas UI. Backend 13/14 pytest, frontend 9/9 tabs + Llamadas row/audio/transcript OK.

minor.issue: The word 'impermeable' still appears literally inside the 'personalizado' template prompt (and inside rescate_oficina as 'nunca impermeable') — the review said impermeable MUST NOT appear anywhere in any template. It is used only as a meta-instruction ("Nunca digas 'impermeable'") so behaviourally the guardrail is safe, but string-level check fails. Consider rephrasing to e.g. "Nunca uses la palabra prohibida (usa antifluido)".

action_items: OPTIONAL: rephrase the 'personalizado' and 'rescate_oficina' templates so the literal substring 'impermeable' never appears (currently used inside a negation instruction).
critical_code_review_comments: custom_agents.py: PATCH allows any single field update via AgentPatch. Retell re-sync only fires when Retell is configured — correct BETA behaviour.
calls.py: webhook has NO auth by design (Retell posts from outside). Confirmed working. list_calls scopes by org from JWT cookie — correct.
agent_tools.py: money-guardrail returns HTTP 200 + {ok:false, requires_human_confirmation:true} as specified (not 400). Good.
consultar_disponibilidad: slots correctly skip Sunday and stay within 08–18 Bogotá; ISO offset -05:00 verified via regex.
AgentIn.tools accepts legacy 'reagendar','terminar_llamada','registrar_pago' — kept for back-compat as intended.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ui_call_it22_a via webhook (cleaned up), TEST_call_it22_001 via webhook (cleaned up), a couple of TEST_ custom agents + agent_tool_calls (all cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter22 verified. RETELL_API_KEY/TELNYX_API_KEY/ELEVEN_API_KEY intentionally empty; test-call correctly returns beta:true with checks={retell:false,telnyx:false,elevenlabs:false}. Note: ELEVEN_API_KEY is checked explicitly in custom_agents.test_call — ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (which is set) is a different variable, and this is on purpose per the BETA branch. Webhook is unauth; /api/calls requires JWT+X-API-Key. Frontend: /app/ajustes has 9 tabs; Llamadas tab uses api.get('/calls') w/ auto JWT.
rca of the issue: Only issue is a strict text-match: template 'personalizado' contains the substring 'impermeable' inside an instruction telling the model NOT to say it. Reproduction: GET /api/custom-agents/templates → templates[personalizado].prompt contains \"Nunca digas 'impermeable' (usa 'antifluido')\". Mitigation: reword to avoid the literal word, e.g. 'Nunca uses la palabra prohibida (usa antifluido)'.
